trace.notes: Normalized the input as zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/5380239. Local source-index rows identify the record as Mike Boyle's 2008 source titled Open problems in symbolic dynamics, DOI 10.1090/conm/469/09161.

Direct local curl to the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge or DNS failure. Exact-work search recovered the DOI landing page, Bowen Notebook metadata page, Mike Boyle's problem-tracking page, CiteSeerX candidate, and the exact-title University of Maryland PDF at https://www.math.umd.edu/~mboyle/papers/openfinalsub3nov2007.pdf.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure. Repeated required Bash downloads of the exact-work PDF from both https://www.math.umd.edu/~mboyle/papers/openfinalsub3nov2007.pdf and http://www.math.umd.edu/~mboyle/papers/openfinalsub3nov2007.pdf failed with curl DNS resolution errors, so no local readable PDF artifact was available for the PDF extraction workflow. The DOI landing page redirected to AMS and then returned a Cloudflare 403. The CiteSeerX PDF candidate redirected through web.archive.org and returned 404. Extraction was not performed from zbMATH metadata, search snippets, or resolver pages.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/5380239.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
